title: One Hidden JSON Field Turned My User Ticket into an Admin Ticket 🚨
summary_en: While testing a ticket creation endpoint, I wasn’t actively looking for a Mass Assignment vulnerability. I simply created a ticket as a normal user and carefully reviewed the API response.
excerpt: While testing a ticket creation endpoint, I wasn’t actively looking for a Mass Assignment vulnerability. I simply created a ticket as a normal user and carefully reviewed the API response.
